section: Microsoft Teams Rooms with Copilot: smart workplace aims, in-room AI features and the Copilot Preparedness Workshop
body:
This Concept Catalog article explains how Microsoft Teams and its AI features support a smart workplace and how Copilot changes hybrid meetings held in Microsoft Teams Rooms. It also names an AVI-SPL workshop for getting Teams Rooms ready for Copilot.

**What to know**

- Context given: work has changed fundamentally, driven by greater demand for flexibility and by the rise of generative AI. Teams brings meetings, chat, calling and collaboration into one place.
- The article says that integrating Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, Teams Premium and Microsoft 365 Copilot gives an organization the tools to lead these changes and not only adapt to them. The stated aims are:
  - Intelligent productivity: focusing on work that matters, with features built for creativity, efficiency and speed of business.
  - Moving from fixed to flexible workplaces: a connected workplace that supports hybrid working in the office, at home or on the go.
  - Rich engagements inside and out: people-centered experiences that deepen connections with colleagues, partners and customers.
  - Protecting the hybrid workforce: letting the business scale up while teams work flexibly, reliably and securely.

**How Copilot enhances meetings in Teams Rooms**

- Speaker recognition identifies each voice in the meeting room. This is what enables the AI-powered intelligent meeting recap and the "Copilot in Teams" experience.
- IntelliFrame gives every face in the room its own place in the meeting gallery, so remote attendees can see people clearly.
- AI-powered noise suppression removes ambient noise from the room, so voices and audio are clearer for remote attendees.
- After the meeting, teams can use Copilot to:
  - Save time: generate summaries and ask specific questions about what each person contributed in a hybrid meeting.
  - Take action: draft an email with highlights and action items for each participant, in-room or remote.
  - Get insights: recap the opinions and perspectives of both in-room and remote attendees.

**AVI-SPL service**

Microsoft Copilot Preparedness Workshop: aimed at organizations whose teams are asking for Copilot but that are unsure whether their systems and network security can support AI capabilities. AVI-SPL offers a collaborative session to review the details and get the customer's Teams Rooms ready for Copilot.

**When to use this**

For questions about what Copilot does in a Teams Room during and after a hybrid meeting, why Teams Rooms and Copilot are positioned together, or how AVI-SPL helps prepare rooms for Copilot.

**Not stated in this source**: which license each feature requires, and the length, agenda or price of the workshop.
